result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there is a noticeable typo in the user's address and a minor inconsistency in the restaurant card layouts.

issues.description: There is a typo in the delivery address string: 'Weizenbergl' instead of 'Weizenbergi'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling of the street name in the address output.

issues.description: The restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' section are missing rating information, which is present in the larger cards in the 'Popular right now' section. This creates an inconsistency in the card design pattern.
issues.suggestion: Either add rating information to the smaller cards or ensure the absence of ratings is a consistent design choice throughout the app.

issues.description: The full-width horizontal separator line above the bottom navigation bar is very dark and visually harsh compared to the softer styling of the rest of the interface.
issues.suggestion: Change the separator line to a lighter gray or use a subtle shadow to better match the overall aesthetic.

issues.description: The number '1' in the red notification badge on the top right bell icon appears slightly off-center towards the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text alignment within the notification badge to ensure the number is perfectly centered.
